ThingDef.label: Tok'ra encoded intelligence packet
ThingDef.description: A small sealed Tok'ra coffer containing encoded intelligence, route fragments, and operational silence protocols for a future discreet mission. Its rigid casing protects an internal data medium intended for a single clandestine delivery. It is neither a trade good nor a true material reward. A colonist capable of Intellectual work can analyze it to prepare a future mission step.
